metadata.step: Step 5 of 8 -- primary evaluation, adaptive robustness and gate decision

reference_baseline_selection.selection_rule: lowest UALER subject to ATPR >= 0.90 on the validation split; if no baseline satisfies the ATPR constraint, the lowest UALER outright (preregistration.yaml primary_comparison.reference_baseline_selection)
reference_baseline_selection.rationale: Selecting the comparator on validation and evaluating on test prevents the comparator from being chosen to flatter AegisLink, and honours CONTRACT.md Section 5.3.

thresholds.fit_note: Evenly spaced design prior. Fitting adjusts the scale on train_development only; the ordering constraint is never relaxed.

frozen_parameters.policy: Loaded from the Step 4 artifact and used verbatim. No parameter is fitted on test, transfer_holdout or adaptive_holdout; FrozenParameters.load raises RefitError unless the Platt fit_regime is train_development, and tests/test_primary_evaluation.py runs a full evaluation with fit_platt replaced by a function that raises.

decision_semantics.GO: all frozen conditions measured and met
decision_semantics.NO_GO: at least one condition was measured and fell short. Produce a pilot decision report documenting which gate failed and why, per CONTRACT.md Section 19 item 2. A NO_GO is a valid, reportable project outcome and MUST NOT be resolved by loosening a threshold.
decision_semantics.INCONCLUSIVE: no condition failed, but at least one could not be measured by this pilot. Distinguished from NO_GO because the remedy differs: complete the measurement rather than stop or change the method. It is NOT a GO.

decision.threshold_mutability: Thresholds are mutable only before pilot execution (CONTRACT.md Section 12). After the first pilot run they are immutable.

misbinding_reproducible.intent: The phenomenon under study must actually occur, and reproducibly.
misbinding_reproducible.pass_condition: At least 2 distinct model families each show at least 2 high-risk actions from the pool whose cells satisfy `cell_reproduces_if`, with >= 20 valid runs per cell.

conditions.reason: NOT EVALUABLE in this pilot. RQ1 asks about web-enabled LLMs; the pilot reader is a deterministic surrogate, so the model-family axis has size 1. Reporting 1 as 2, or substituting the three retrieval configurations for model families, would invent the measurement the gate asks for.

evidence.why_not_evaluable: RQ1 asks about web-enabled LLMs. This pilot has no LLM in the loop; the reader is deterministic, which is what makes the replay bit-reproducible and every between-defense comparison exact. One deterministic reader is one reader.
evidence.what_would_evaluate_it: Substitute >= 2 pinned open-weight LLM readers behind the same parsers/ extraction path, replay the frozen snapshot through each, and recompute the (model_family, action) cells. Nothing else in this gate changes.

baseline_not_trivial.intent: The problem must not already be solved by an existing defense. If some baseline already achieves both low unauthorized exposure AND high authorized-third-party retention, AegisLink is unnecessary and the pilot MUST stop.
baseline_not_trivial.pass_condition: NO Section 10 baseline is trivially sufficient, i.e. for every baseline (UALER > 0.10) OR (ATPR < 0.90).

conditions.test: no baseline achieves UALER <= 0.1 while ALSO achieving ATPR >= 0.9 (conjunctive; this condition reports the UALER axis of that single test)
conditions.reason: Among baselines meeting the ATPR floor, the lowest UALER is 0.145833, above the 0.1 ceiling, so none is trivially sufficient.

evidence.evaluation_split_rationale: Gate decisions are made on the validation split so the test split remains untouched for the confirmatory analysis (CONTRACT.md Section 5.3).
evidence.triviality_condition: A baseline is TRIVIALLY SUFFICIENT if it simultaneously achieves UALER <= max_allowed_best_baseline_ualer (0.10) AND ATPR >= min_required_baseline_atpr (0.90).
evidence.conjunction_rationale: The two thresholds are deliberately applied as a conjunction rather than as two independent gates. Baseline 8 ("reject all login and pay links") and baseline 9 ("allow only the registry-listed official domain") can both drive UALER below 0.10 while destroying ATPR. Treating the UALER threshold alone as disqualifying would let those degenerate defenses veto the project even though they fail the utility requirement that CONTRACT.md Section 4.2 makes central. Only a baseline that is good on BOTH axes makes the research question moot.

method.gate_source: preregistration.yaml hard_gates (never a literal in this module)
method.why_three_valued: FAIL means the pilot measured the thing and it fell short. NOT_EVALUABLE means the pilot could not measure it, which is a different fact and would be misreported as either a pass or a failure. Both block GO.
method.baseline_not_trivial_conjunction: Its two frozen values read ONE conjunctive test. Reported as two conditions with separate margins, but a baseline disqualifies the project only by being good on both axes at once -- otherwise B08 and B09 could veto the work while failing the utility requirement Section 4.2 makes central.

known_unevaluable.misbinding_reproducible.min_model_famili: requires >= 2 LLM model families; this pilot's reader is a deterministic surrogate, so the axis has size 1. Reported NOT_EVALUABLE rather than satisfied by substituting retrieval configurations for model families.
